describes: Lime mortar in a fieldstone plinth's joints: pale when struck, darkening with damp and dirt in the deep joints.

notes.srgb: Judged by look; a joint at Dale is dark, never black (LT1Stone's soil note).
notes.water: Its water profile as the town's (Shaders/Water.hlsl, Overstory.World.WaterPack): how much it darkens wet, how glossy its wet film, how long it holds water, how readily run-off stains it. Lime soaks it up and stays dark. Judged by look.
notes.jointView: The share of the sky, the ground and a lamp a joint's back sees between its rounded stones: a joint of 20 mm, 40 mm back, between arrises that fall away. At 0.3 every joint drew a black line round its stone, a cobble; 0.5 by look (round 9).
